conflicts.permit: Used to identify users to our customer support representatives when they visit our support page
conflicts.prohibit: These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.
conflicts.situation: When a visitor browses the support page and the necessary Zendesk session cookies identify the specific user to customer support representatives.
conflicts.reason: Necessary cookies are flatly asserted not to store any personally identifiable data, yet Zendesk cookies in that same category explicitly identify individual users.
